candidates.title: When the KV Cache Is Slower Than the GPU: Scaling Remote KV Tiers for Context-Parallel Prefill
candidates.abstract: Reusing the attention KV cache across requests is a standard way to cut prefill cost in long-context LLM serving, and production systems increasingly back the per-engine cache with a remote tier shared by every engine. We study such a tier in a disaggregated deployment of GLM-5.3, an FP8 mixture-of-experts model with multi-head latent attention (MLA), on 8xB300 nodes running prefill context parallelism (PCP8). Enabling the remote tier (LMCache with a Valkey store) left median time-to-first-token unchanged but raised the 16k-token p99 from 3.96 s to 17.3 s. Replaying a production request stream on an isolated engine, we find that a remote hit took 0.88 s against 0.31 s to recompute the prompt, and that synchronous loading turned a hit-heavy stream into an unstable queue: p99 83.32 s with the GPUs 7% busy. A two-term cost model explains both: a hit pays off only if the tier delivers more than B* = sR (2.53 GB/s for this model and GPU), and a fixed per-hit engine cost (T0 ~ 0.33 s) means that hits on prompts shorter than about 17k tokens cannot beat recompute at any bandwidth. Guided by the model, we (i) shard the MLA KV store across PCP ranks, with a proof that the existing minimum-over-ranks lookup returns the longest cached prefix and a load protocol that can never desynchronize collectives; (ii) partition the remote tier by rank, one server instance per rank with no coordination, which raises GET bandwidth 6.3x to 10.76 GB/s; (iii) add asynchronous loading to the sharded store; and (iv) fix three client bugs that caused unbounded stalls. On the hit-heavy stream, with 98.5% of prompt tokens served from the remote tier, p99 falls from 83.32 s to 0.67 s. The sharded store raises prefill throughput by 14%, and by 34% together with an upstream kernel fix. All changes are submitted upstream to LMCache.
candidates.reason: 8xB300上のGLM-5.3/MLA/PCP8で遠隔KV tierのhitが再計算より遅くなり得る問題を測定する。著者要旨では16K promptのp99 TTFTが3.96→17.3秒へ悪化し、hit当たりの固定費用と帯域の損益分岐を定式化。PCP rank別KV分割、非同期転送、client stall修正によりhit-heavy traceのp99を83.32→0.67秒へ改善し、prefill throughputを14%増と報告。遠隔KVの実装/性能境界を直接扱うためaccept。

candidates.title: TideKV: Delayed KV eviction via layer-wise chunked prefill for memory-efficient long-context LLM inference
candidates.abstract: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference is important for modern intelligent applications but remains constrained by peak memory during prompt prefill. Existing KV cache compression reduces decoding memory but typically requires full-prompt prefill to preserve global context, retaining a high construction peak. Online chunk-level eviction lowers memory earlier but selects before each layer has observed the complete prompt, potentially degrading cache construction and decoding. We present TideKV, an on-GPU cache-construction architecture using layer-major delayed eviction. TideKV processes all prompt chunks within each Transformer layer, retains full-prompt KV only for the active layer, and evicts at layer end. This schedule preserves full-prompt-aware selection while reducing activation and temporary memory. Experiments across multiple computing platforms show that TideKV preserves the inference quality and final cache size of the evaluated compression methods. At 64K on A100, it reduces the construction-time transient footprint by 83.89%. On RTX 4090, it increases time to first token by only 1.06% at 64K and enables 128K prefill. TideKV also completes 128K on Jetson, whereas matched post-prefill compression runs out of memory on both resource-constrained platforms. These results show that delayed layer-end eviction substantially expands feasible context lengths without sacrificing cache utility.
candidates.reason: 全promptをprefillしてからKVを圧縮すると構築時の一時メモリが大きく、chunkごとの早期追い出しは全prompt情報を見ずに選択する問題に対し、層優先で全chunkを処理し各層終了時にのみKVを削除する。著者要旨はA100の64Kで構築時一時メモリ83.89%削減、RTX4090の64KでTTFT増加1.06%に留め128K prefillを可能にしたと報告。長文脈推論のcache構築時メモリ最適化としてaccept。

candidates.title: BiLoCo: Binary Low-Rank Corrections for Post-Training Quantization
candidates.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) to FP4 has emerged as a key technique for reducing large language model inference cost, especially on Blackwell GPUs, which offer native FP4 tensor core support. Direct PTQ to FP4, however, still leaves a noticeable accuracy gap. Recent work on SVDQuant mitigates the errors introduced through FP4 quantization for diffusion models by adding high-precision low-rank corrections obtained via SVD. However, this high-precision low-rank correction requires many bits per rank, and it runs on the same tensor cores as the main FP4 GEMM. We introduce BiLoCo, a low-rank correction method whose left and right factors are stored as binary ${\{\pm 1\}}$ sign vectors rather than as BF16 numbers. The signed format uses $16{\times}$ less storage per rank-one component, and since the correction now consists of additions/subtractions, this can be run on CUDA cores concurrently with the FP4 tensor-core GEMM. On 4B--72B LLMs, BiLoCo matches or improves memory-matched SVDQuant for PTQ. We implement BiLoCo on B300 as a fused single kernel, where the FP4 GEMM runs on tensor cores, the bit-packed correction on the CUDA cores of the same launch, and the two are combined in the GEMM epilogue. With batch size $1$, the fused kernel is at most $11\%$ slower than the FP4-only GEMM for every rank up to $512$. At rank $128$, it is at most $20\%$ slower up to batch size $8$.
candidates.reason: FP4 PTQの誤差補正を高精度SVD低ランク行列でなく、±1符号のbinary低ランク因子で表す。rank当たりの格納量を16分の1に抑え、FP4 GEMMをtensor core、補正をCUDA coreで同一kernel内に並列実行する。著者要旨は4B～72B LLMでメモリを合わせたSVDQuant同等以上の品質、B300のbatch1でrank512までFP4単独GEMM比11%以内の実行遅延と報告。量子化誤差補正とカーネルの直接的貢献としてaccept。

candidates.title: MCF: A Memory- and Communication-Aware Co-Designed Framework for Long-Context LLM Inference
candidates.abstract: This paper presents Memory- and Communication-Aware Framework for Long-Context LLM Inference (MCF) that optimizes long-context inference through communication-aware and stage-adaptive KV-cache layout transitions. At the core of MCF is {Memory-Aware Replication and Scheduling} (MARS), a dynamic orchestration mechanism for chunked prefill. MARS exploits early-stage memory headroom by selectively replicating highly reused KV blocks, improving locality and hiding KV propagation latency behind attention computation. As prefill progresses and memory pressure increases, MARS progressively drains redundant replicas and converges the KV cache into a sharded decode-ready layout, avoiding expensive layout conversion at the prefill--decode boundary. For decoding, MCF adopts a query-centric execution model in which KV shards remain stationary while lightweight query tensors are routed across workers. This changes communication from KV-cache-dependent transfer to query-dependent transfer, reducing communication growth with context length. MCF further integrates a hardware-software co-designed execution layer based on an FPGA compute-NIC datapath, enabling metadata-driven KV routing and collective operations directly in the network path. Experiments show that MCF improves TTFT, throughput, and scalability over state-of-the-art distributed inference systems, with larger benefits as context length and cluster size increase.
candidates.reason: 長文脈のchunked prefill初期に余剰メモリへ再利用KVを複製し、進行につれて冗長コピーを解放してdecode用shardへ移行するMARSと、KV shardを固定しqueryをworker間で移動するdecode方式を組み合わせる。さらにFPGA compute-NICでmetadata-driven KV routingとcollectiveを処理する。著者要旨はTTFT/throughput/scalability改善を主張するが具体的倍率は示していない。長文脈LLM推論の通信・KV配置協調設計としてaccept。
